desc: The Browning X-Bolt Special Max LR is the rifle that is designed for the open range and the target range. It includes the features you want for precision competition, as well as the adjustability to optimize how your body interacts with the rifle. The foundation of this rifle is its heavy sporter barrel that is equipped with suppressor ready 5/8"-24 threads. The receiver's additional bolt guidance surface offers smooth cycling and bind-free performance. The bolt features a longer handle to reduce the force needed to open the bolt. Cartridges are fed from the center of the patented rotary magazine for straight to the chamber feeding. The magazine also has shoulder retention to protect the tip of the bullet from striking the front of the magazine during recoil. The adjustable DLX Trigger brings the light touch you need for accurate shooting. This three-lever design has zero creep, zero take-up, zero overtravel, and a glass-like break. Adjustability is key to precision and the Max stock gives you the versatility to customize the comb to dial in the alignment between your eye and optics. The 1” thick Inflex recoil pad tames felt recoil.
